questions: Did the group discuss rolling specific dice (such as D6 or D20) to determine whether an action succeeded?
Was a numeric target number or threshold (e.g., needing to roll a 14 or higher, or beating an armor class of 15) discussed as part of resolving an action?
Did the group discuss saving throws and a bonus (such as a +2 poison resistance for trollkin) as a game mechanic?
Did the group discuss an optional "fumble" rule for ranged attacks accidentally hitting an ally on a roll of one?
Was there discussion of experience points, leveling up, or gaining a mechanical follower as game procedure?

Did participants make out-of-character jokes or references to real-world media, stereotypes, or other games (such as Water World, Call of Cthulhu dice, Blades in the Dark, or comments about yarmulkes and horns)?
